analyst.summary: Aequs is a precision aerospace-components manufacturer riding a genuine global trend of supply chains shifting work to India, with a large order book and fast-growing revenue. The company is still loss-making today, however, burning cash as it scales and showing early signs of stretched working capital, and further growth will likely require additional capital that could dilute existing shareholders. We rate this a Sell until profitability and cash generation catch up with the growth.
